title: Produce search component audit sheet
description: Audit the search filter as an individual text-input component with placeholder, clear action, debounce, feedback, and state contracts.
objective: Define search as a first-class filter component rather than generic field styling.
acceptance_criteria: Label, input, placeholder, optional icon, clear action, focus, hover, disabled, debounce/loading feedback, and responsive behavior are treated as separate subelements.
Search is distinguished from generic input styling.
The audit does not implement search fixes yet.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: search render, field CSS, frontend JS

risks: Search can appear simple while hiding debounce, clear, and feedback edge cases.
A missing empty/loading state can make filtering feel broken.
